findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: recommend-llm-model · Private data: estimate-llm-cost, compare-models-side-by-side, estimate-self-hosting-breakeven · Public sink: estimate-self-hosting-breakeven.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: recommend-llm-model · Private data: estimate-llm-cost, compare-models-side-by-side, estimate-self-hosting-breakeven · Public sink: estimate-self-hosting-breakeven

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "compare-llm-models" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
